infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nomi uses the microphone while you record a note, or during a networking session you start, to remember the people you meet.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Nomi turns your spoken notes into text, on your iPhone whenever possible.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Nomi lets you choose people from your contacts to remember. Your address book stays on your phone.
